# Style 05 · Future Tech

> Light from a dark screen.

**Keywords:** Intelligent · Fast · Precise · Immersive · Ambitious  
**Mood:** Technical · Bold · Premium  
**Sectors:** Technology & SaaS · Finance & professional services · Media, arts & culture  
**Strongest applications:** Websites · Presentations · Social media · Advertising · Events

> **Fictional sample brand.** Ortelia, ai analytics platform, and every person, figure and address in its examples are invented to demonstrate this style. This is not client work. Domains use the reserved `.example` TLD.

## Concept

Future Tech is built on a deep dark base with glowing accents, layered glass panels and precise geometric type. It suggests speed, intelligence and scale, and lets product UI be the main visual.

## Target industries

- SaaS and AI products
- Fintech and crypto
- Cybersecurity
- Telecom and connectivity
- Gaming and esports platforms
- Tech conferences

## Color palette

| Name | Hex | Role | Share |
| --- | --- | --- | ---: |
| Void | `#0A0B14` | Primary background | 55% |
| Hull | `#151830` | Panels, cards | 20% |
| Frost | `#E6E8F2` | Text | 12% |
| Ion Violet | `#6C55F2` | Primary accent, gradients | 7% |
| Plasma Cyan | `#2DE2E6` | Data highlights, links | 4% |
| Signal Pink | `#FF5CA8` | Alerts, gradient end | 2% |

**Rule:** Gradients only run between Ion Violet, Plasma Cyan and Signal Pink, and only on dark backgrounds. Never set body text in an accent colour.

## Typography

| Role | Family | Weights | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Display | **Sora** | 300, 600 | Headlines, big metrics |
| Body | **Manrope** | 400, 500 | Body, UI |
| Utility | **IBM Plex Mono** | 400 | Code, metrics, timestamps |
| Arabic | **Readex Pro** | | Geometric and variable, with matching low contrast. Works well in dark UI. |

**Type scale** (desktop, px size / line height)

| Level | Size | Weight | Detail |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Display | 72 / 76 | 600 | -3% tracking, gradient fill allowed |
| H1 | 44 / 50 | 600 | -2% tracking |
| H2 | 24 / 30 | 300 | Light weight for contrast |
| Body | 16 / 26 | 400 | Frost at 80% opacity |
| Mono | 12 / 16 | 400 | Uppercase, +8% tracking |

- A gradient fill is allowed on one headline per layout.
- Use mono for data, versions and status labels.
- Use 80% Frost for body text to reduce glare on dark backgrounds.

## Layout rules

- **Grid:** 12 columns · 24px gutter · centred 1200px container
- **Spacing:** 8px base. Sections float on the dark field with 128px spacing.
- **Corners:** 16px panels · 10px buttons

- Layer translucent glass panels over glow fields.
- Product UI is the hero visual. Show the real interface.
- Use a faint dot or line grid in the background.
- Light comes from behind: radial glows behind key elements.
- Data and metrics get their own bold modules.

## Photography direction

Minimal photography. Product UI, 3D renders and abstract light.

- Prefer UI screenshots and 3D abstract renders over photos.
- When using people: low-key light, screen glow on faces.
- Add neon rim light in Violet or Cyan.
- Grade cool with crushed blacks.
- Abstract fibre-optic or data-flow imagery as backgrounds.

**Sample shot list**

1. Engineer lit by monitor glow, low key (grade: `#2A2560` → `#6C55F2` → `#0A0B14`)
2. Abstract light trails, long exposure (grade: `#2DE2E6` → `#6C55F2` → `#0A0B14`)
3. 3D glass shape with pink rim light (grade: `#FF5CA8` → `#3B2D8F` → `#0A0B14`)

**Avoid**

- Bright daylight office stock
- Warm colour grades
- Cluttered desk shots

## Graphic elements

- Gradient mesh glow fields
- Frosted glass panels with a 1px light border
- Dot and line grids
- Data lines, nodes and orbit paths
- Glowing status indicators

## UI examples

- Primary button: violet-to-cyan gradient with a soft glow on hover.
- Glass cards: 6% white fill, 1px 12% white border, backdrop blur.
- Inputs: dark fill, focus ring in Plasma Cyan.
- Charts in Cyan and Violet on a faint grid.

- Primary button: `Start free trial` · Secondary button: `Watch demo`
- Input: Work email: `lina@northwind.io`
- Tags: `Live` `v4.2` `SOC 2`
- Card: **Revenue forecast**, Updated 2 min ago, +24.7%

## Social media examples

## Website example

- Dark hero with a gradient headline and a floating product UI.
- Logo wall of customers in 40% Frost.
- Feature grid of glass cards with small glowing icons.

- **Navigation:** Product · Solutions · Pricing · Docs
- **Hero eyebrow:** AI analytics
- **Hero headline:** Ask your data anything.
- **Hero copy:** Ortelia connects to your warehouse and answers business questions in plain language.
- **Actions:** Start free trial / Watch demo
- **Proof row:** 3s (Median answer time) · 200+ (Native data connectors) · SOC 2 (Type II certified)

## Advertising campaign

**Campaign:** Ask Anything

The ad is the product: a real business question typed into Ortelia, with the answer appearing beneath it.

| Format | Eyebrow | Headline | CTA |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Billboard 48-sheet (6096 × 3048 mm) | Ortelia · AI analytics | Ask your data anything. | ortelia.example |
| Display MPU 300 × 250 and leaderboard 728 × 90 | | Forecasts in 3 seconds. | Start free |

- Prefer digital and illuminated sites: dark creative glows at night.
- Show real UI fragments, never robots or circuit boards.
- Banner loop: the question types, the answer appears, 6 seconds.

## Presentations

- **Cover slide:** Product keynote 2027 · **Ask your data anything.** · Ortelia 4.2 launch · sample deck
- **Content slide:** Why teams switch. Key figure **3s** (median answer time); points: 200+ native connectors; Answers cite their source tables; SOC 2 Type II. Figures are sample data.

- Dark slides with one glow field each.
- Gradient text on one keyword per section.
- Live product demos instead of screenshots where possible.

## Brand applications

Business card, letterhead and email signature for **Lina Haddad**, Head of Product Marketing (`lina@ortelia.example`, fictional).

| Application | Specification |
| --- | --- |
| Event stage | LED wall with glow field, glass lecterns |
| Swag | matte black notebooks with cyan foil logo |
| Office | dark meeting rooms with violet edge lighting |
| App icon | violet orb with cyan rim on Void |

- Glows need a dark ground. On white, use the flat Ion Violet logo.
- Foil and LED replace gradients in physical applications.
- Motion is part of the brand: logo assembles from data points in 1.2s.

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Show the real product | Gradients on light backgrounds |
| Use glow sparingly as light, not decoration | Accent-coloured paragraphs |
| Keep text contrast high | Generic robot or circuit-board imagery |

## Design tokens

Text in the accent colour uses `--avdl-accent-text`, which passes WCAG AA (4.5:1) on both `bg` and `surface`.

```css
[data-style="future-tech"] {
  --avdl-bg: #0A0B14;
  --avdl-surface: #151830;
  --avdl-ink: #E6E8F2;
  --avdl-muted: #A3A8C3;
  --avdl-accent: #6C55F2;
  --avdl-accent-text: #9C88FF;
  --avdl-accent-2: #2DE2E6;
  --avdl-on-accent: #FFFFFF;
  --avdl-line: rgba(230,232,242,0.14);
  --avdl-font-display: 'Sora', 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif;
  --avdl-font-body: 'Manrope', 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif;
  --avdl-display-weight: 600;
  --avdl-display-case: none;
  --avdl-display-tracking: -0.03em;
  --avdl-radius: 16px;
  --avdl-button-radius: 10px;
  --avdl-border-width: 1px;
  --avdl-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(108,85,242,0.35);
  --avdl-color-void: #0A0B14;
  --avdl-color-hull: #151830;
  --avdl-color-frost: #E6E8F2;
  --avdl-color-ion-violet: #6C55F2;
  --avdl-color-plasma-cyan: #2DE2E6;
  --avdl-color-signal-pink: #FF5CA8;
}
```
